description: This PHP source file manages product addition, deletion, and display in an e-commerce admin panel. It handles form submission for adding new products with images, interacts with the database to insert, fetch, and delete product records, and renders the HTML interface for managing products.

methods.name: add_product
methods.description: Handles form submission to add a new product, including sanitizing inputs, checking for existing product name, inserting new product records in database, and uploading images.

methods.name: delete_product
methods.description: Deletes a product and its associated images, cart, and wishlist entries based on provided product ID.
